Suburban Furnace Core replacements give an alternative 
to pulling and replacing old and worn parts, one at a time.
Why repair a furnace with individual parts when you can 
simply install a furnace core? 
Give your customer reliable comfort and peace of mind.  
Each Suburban Furnace Core replacement is backed by a 
Two (2) Year Limited Warranty.
Replace the Core, 
Not the Whole Furnace...
•	
Reduce repair costs and cycle time at the dealership
•	
Decrease the chances for diagnostic errors
•	
Increase dealer revenue
•	
Provide a furnace upgrade with a new 2-year warranty
